description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Granting permission for a person to make payments in foreign exchange to a person resident outside Sri Lanka using an EFTC in terms of Sections 7 and 8 of the Exchange Control Act
reasoning: This gazette notice contains regulatory permissions and terms/conditions for foreign exchange transactions using Electronic Fund Transfer Cards, issued under the Exchange Control Act. It establishes legal/compliance requirements for financial transactions, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel/structure matter.
